item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus
item.brief:
Goal: Refactor the orders crate to use a typed order status, preserving existing observable behavior, and commit the work.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returning exactly "pending", "paid", "shipped", or "cancelled"; Display prints the same.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError. ParseStatusError must be public, implement std::error::Error, and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool for exactly: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. All other transitions return false.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root, and use the enum throughout the crate so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes.
- Commit the change.

Acceptance criteria: implementation satisfies all requirements above; cargo test passes; the repository change is committed.
